```{python}
            topk_by_visit=topk_by_visit,
            segment_abstain_threshold=DEFAULT_SEGMENT_ABSTAIN_THRESHOLD,
            visit_emit_threshold=DEFAULT_VISIT_EMIT_THRESHOLD,
            top_k_cutoff=DEFAULT_VISIT_TOPK_CUTOFF,
        )
    )
    for threshold in SEGMENT_ABSTAIN_THRESHOLDS:
        pred_sets = _prediction_sets_from_segment_candidates(
            segment_scores,
            segment_abstain_threshold=threshold,
            n_visits=len(gold_sets),
        )
        rows.append(
            summarize_prediction_setting(
                gold_sets,
                pred_sets,
                setting_type="segment_abstention",
                setting_label=f"segment_abstain_threshold={threshold:.2f}",
                topk_by_visit=topk_by_visit,
                segment_abstain_threshold=threshold,
                visit_emit_threshold=DEFAULT_VISIT_EMIT_THRESHOLD,
                top_k_cutoff=DEFAULT_VISIT_TOPK_CUTOFF,
            )
        )
    for visit_threshold in VISIT_EMIT_THRESHOLDS:
        for top_k_cutoff in VISIT_TOPK_CUTOFFS:
            pred_sets = _prediction_sets_from_visit_candidates(
                visit_scores,
                score_threshold=visit_threshold,
                top_k_cutoff=top_k_cutoff,
            )
            rows.append(
                summarize_prediction_setting(
                    gold_sets,
                    pred_sets,
                    setting_type="visit_emit_topk",
                    setting_label=f"visit_emit_threshold={visit_threshold:.2f};top_k={top_k_cutoff}",
                    topk_by_visit=topk_by_visit,
                    segment_abstain_threshold=DEFAULT_SEGMENT_ABSTAIN_THRESHOLD,
                    visit_emit_threshold=visit_threshold,
                    top_k_cutoff=top_k_cutoff,
                )
            )
    for uncodable_threshold in VISIT_UNCODABLE_THRESHOLDS:
        pred_sets = _prediction_sets_from_visit_candidates(
            visit_scores,
            score_threshold=DEFAULT_VISIT_EMIT_THRESHOLD,
            top_k_cutoff=DEFAULT_VISIT_TOPK_CUTOFF,
            uncodable_threshold=uncodable_threshold,
        )
        rows.append(
            summarize_prediction_setting(
                gold_sets,
                pred_sets,
                setting_type="visit_uncodable",
                setting_label=f"visit_uncodable_threshold={uncodable_threshold:.2f}",
                topk_by_visit=topk_by_visit,
                segment_abstain_threshold=DEFAULT_SEGMENT_ABSTAIN_THRESHOLD,
                visit_emit_threshold=DEFAULT_VISIT_EMIT_THRESHOLD,
                top_k_cutoff=DEFAULT_VISIT_TOPK_CUTOFF,
                visit_uncodable_threshold=uncodable_threshold,
            )
        )
    sweep = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    for column in ("coverage_rate", "abstention_rate", "uncodable_only_rate"):
        assert_rate_bounds(sweep[column], f"threshold sweep {column}")
    if not np.allclose(sweep["coverage_rate"] + sweep["abstention_rate"], 1.0):
        raise AssertionError("threshold sweep coverage_rate + abstention_rate must equal 1.")
    return sweep


def save_threshold_plots(threshold_sweep: pd.DataFrame, *, output_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path]:
    """Save coverage and Jaccard threshold sweep plots."""
    coverage_path = output_dir / "R3_vs_NLP_coverage_vs_threshold.png"
    jaccard_path = output_dir / "R3_vs_NLP_jaccard_vs_threshold.png"
    heatmap_path = output_dir / "R3_vs_NLP_threshold_heatmap.png"

    plot_df = threshold_sweep.loc[threshold_sweep["setting_type"].ne("default")].copy()
    plot_df["plot_threshold"] = plot_df["segment_abstain_threshold"].fillna(plot_df["visit_emit_threshold"]).fillna(plot_df["visit_uncodable_threshold"])

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4.0))
    for setting_type, group in plot_df.groupby("setting_type", dropna=False):
        ax.plot(group["plot_threshold"], group["coverage_rate"], marker="o", label=str(setting_type))
    ax.set_xlabel("Threshold")
    ax.set_ylabel("Coverage rate")
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax.set_title("Coverage across post-hoc threshold settings")
    ax.legend(fontsize=8)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(coverage_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
    plt.close(fig)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4.0))
    for setting_type, group in plot_df.groupby("setting_type", dropna=False):
        ax.plot(group["plot_threshold"], group["mean_jaccard"], marker="o", label=str(setting_type))
    ax.set_xlabel("Threshold")
    ax.set_ylabel("Mean Jaccard")
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax.set_title("Mean Jaccard across post-hoc threshold settings")
    ax.legend(fontsize=8)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(jaccard_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
    plt.close(fig)

    heatmap_df = threshold_sweep.loc[threshold_sweep["setting_type"].eq("visit_emit_topk")].copy()
    heatmap_matrix = heatmap_df.pivot_table(
        index="visit_emit_threshold",
        columns="top_k_cutoff",
        values="mean_jaccard",
        aggfunc="mean",
    )
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 4.2))
    image = ax.imshow(heatmap_matrix.to_numpy(), cmap="Greys", aspect="auto", vmin=0, vmax=1)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(heatmap_matrix.columns)))
    ax.set_xticklabels([str(int(value)) for value in heatmap_matrix.columns])
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(heatmap_matrix.index)))
    ax.set_yticklabels([f"{float(value):.2f}" for value in heatmap_matrix.index])
    ax.set_xlabel("Top-K cutoff")
    ax.set_ylabel("Visit emit threshold")
    ax.set_title("Mean Jaccard by visit threshold and top-K cutoff")
    for row_idx in range(heatmap_matrix.shape[0]):
        for col_idx in range(heatmap_matrix.shape[1]):
            value = heatmap_matrix.iloc[row_idx, col_idx]
            if pd.notna(value):
                ax.text(col_idx, row_idx, f"{value:.2f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8)
    fig.colorbar(image, ax=ax, label="Mean Jaccard")
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(heatmap_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
    plt.close(fig)
    return coverage_path, jaccard_path, heatmap_path
```

```{python}
#| label: rater-agreement-analysis-cell-003
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Analysis A: Human rater agreement (R1, R2, R3)
#
# Workflow:
# 1) Load validated annotation/category inputs.
# 2) Convert each visit to an unordered set of categories per rater.
# 3) Compute set-level metrics and chance-corrected binary metrics.
# 4) Run assertions, then write reproducible output artifacts.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Canonical category names define the fixed category universe used for
# binary one-vs-rest metrics.
CANONICAL_CATS = load_categories_from_sheet(
    ANNOTATION_PATH,
    sheet=CATEGORY_SHEET,
    column=CATEGORY_COLUMN,
)

df = read_sheet_checked(ANNOTATION_PATH, ANNOTATION_SHEET)

# Validate required rater columns up front so missing data fails early.
key_cols = ["hadm_id", "subject_id"]
required_rater_cols = key_cols + [
    f"annot{r}_rvs{i}_cat"
    for r in (1, 2, 3)
    for i in range(1, 6)
]
validate_required_columns(df, required_rater_cols, "Annotation sheet")
validate_unique_keys(df, key_cols, "Annotation sheet")

r1_sets = extract_rater_sets(df, 1)
r2_sets = extract_rater_sets(df, 2)
r3_sets = extract_rater_sets(df, 3)

assert len(r1_sets) == len(df), "R1 set count must equal annotation row count"
assert len(r2_sets) == len(df), "R2 set count must equal annotation row count"
assert len(r3_sets) == len(df), "R3 set count must equal annotation row count"

# Pairwise set-level agreement captures visit-level overlap/exactness.
pair12_df, pair12_summary = summarize_set_agreement(r1_sets, r2_sets)
pair13_df, pair13_summary = summarize_set_agreement(r1_sets, r3_sets)
pair23_df, pair23_summary = summarize_set_agreement(r2_sets, r3_sets)

three_summary = summarize_three_way(r1_sets, r2_sets, r3_sets)

# Chance-corrected metrics require binary matrices by category.
raters_sets = {"r1": r1_sets, "r2": r2_sets, "r3": r3_sets}
bin_mats = flatten_binary_decisions(raters_sets, CANONICAL_CATS)

for rater_name, mat in bin_mats.items():
    assert mat.shape == (len(df), len(CANONICAL_CATS)), (
        f"{rater_name} binary matrix shape mismatch: expected "
        f"({len(df)}, {len(CANONICAL_CATS)}), got {mat.shape}"
    )

pw12 = pairwise_binary_agreement_stats(bin_mats["r1"], bin_mats["r2"])
pw13 = pairwise_binary_agreement_stats(bin_mats["r1"], bin_mats["r3"])
pw23 = pairwise_binary_agreement_stats(bin_mats["r2"], bin_mats["r3"])

category_code_map = {i: c for i, c in enumerate(CANONICAL_CATS)}
category_label_map = {i: canonical_label_for_code(c) for i, c in enumerate(CANONICAL_CATS)}
for df_pw in (pw12, pw13, pw23):
    df_pw["category_code"] = df_pw["category"].map(category_code_map)
    df_pw["category_name"] = df_pw["category"].map(category_label_map)

multi_ac1 = multirater_ac1_per_category([bin_mats["r1"], bin_mats["r2"], bin_mats["r3"]])
multi_ac1["category_code"] = multi_ac1["category"].map(category_code_map)
multi_ac1["category_name"] = multi_ac1["category"].map(category_label_map)

pair12_chance = summarize_kappa_ac1(pw12)
pair13_chance = summarize_kappa_ac1(pw13)
pair23_chance = summarize_kappa_ac1(pw23)

multi_macro_ac1 = multi_ac1["gwet_ac1"].mean()
multi_macro_agree = multi_ac1["percent_agreement"].mean()

# Deterministic validation checks
# These assertions guard against silent failures (shape drift, out-of-range
# rates, and missing expected columns).
for summary_name, summary in (
    ("pair12_summary", pair12_summary),
    ("pair13_summary", pair13_summary),
    ("pair23_summary", pair23_summary),
):
    assert int(summary["N_items"]) == len(df), f"{summary_name} N_items mismatch"
    assert_rate_bounds(summary[["exact_rate", "partial_rate", "none_rate"]], f"{summary_name} rates")
    assert_rate_bounds(summary[["mean_jaccard", "mean_overlap", "mean_f1_set", "micro_f1_set"]], f"{summary_name} similarity metrics")

assert_rate_bounds(three_summary[["full_rate", "partial_rate", "none_rate"]], "three_summary rates")
assert int(three_summary["N_items"]) == len(df), "three_summary N_items mismatch"

for label, df_pw in (("pw12", pw12), ("pw13", pw13), ("pw23", pw23)):
    assert_expected_columns(
        df_pw,
        ["category", "N", "percent_agreement", "cohen_kappa", "gwet_ac1", "category_code", "category_name"],
        label,
    )
    assert len(df_pw) == len(CANONICAL_CATS), f"{label} row count mismatch with categories"
    assert_rate_bounds(df_pw["percent_agreement"], f"{label} percent_agreement")
    assert_rate_bounds(df_pw["gwet_ac1"], f"{label} gwet_ac1")

assert_expected_columns(
    multi_ac1,
    ["category", "percent_agreement", "gwet_ac1", "prevalence", "category_code", "category_name"],
    "multi_ac1",
)
assert len(multi_ac1) == len(CANONICAL_CATS), "multi_ac1 row count mismatch with categories"
assert_rate_bounds(multi_ac1["percent_agreement"], "multi_ac1 percent_agreement")
assert_rate_bounds(multi_ac1["gwet_ac1"], "multi_ac1 gwet_ac1")

# Output filenames are intentionally unchanged to preserve downstream
# manuscript/report references.
# Outputs
pair12_df.to_csv(RATERS_OUTPUT_DIR / "pair_R1_R2_set_metrics.csv", index=False)
pair13_df.to_csv(RATERS_OUTPUT_DIR / "pair_R1_R3_set_metrics.csv", index=False)
pair23_df.to_csv(RATERS_OUTPUT_DIR / "pair_R2_R3_set_metrics.csv", index=False)

pw12.to_csv(RATERS_OUTPUT_DIR / "pair_R1_R2_binary_stats.csv", index=False)
pw13.to_csv(RATERS_OUTPUT_DIR / "pair_R1_R3_binary_stats.csv", index=False)
pw23.to_csv(RATERS_OUTPUT_DIR / "pair_R2_R3_binary_stats.csv", index=False)

multi_ac1.to_csv(RATERS_OUTPUT_DIR / "all3_multirater_ac1_by_category.csv", index=False)

adj_summary = adjudication_resolution(r1_sets, r2_sets, r3_sets)

summary_text = f"""
=== Pairwise set-level (order-invariant) ===

R1 vs R2:
{pair12_summary.to_string()}

R1 vs R3:
{pair13_summary.to_string()}

R2 vs R3:
{pair23_summary.to_string()}

=== Three-rater set-level (full/partial/none) ===
{three_summary.to_string()}

=== Chance-corrected (binary per category) ===
R1 vs R2:
{pair12_chance.to_string()}

R1 vs R3:
{pair13_chance.to_string()}

R2 vs R3:
{pair23_chance.to_string()}

=== Multi-rater AC1 (3 raters) ===
macro_gwet_ac1={multi_macro_ac1:.4f}
macro_percent_agreement={multi_macro_agree:.4f}

=== Adjudication (R3) for R1≠R2 ===
{adj_summary.to_string()}
"""

(RATERS_OUTPUT_DIR / "summary.txt").write_text(summary_text)

print(summary_text)
note_export(RATERS_OUTPUT_DIR / "summary.txt")
```

## Agreement with NLP Pipeline

**Rationale:** Compare adjudicated human labels with NLP outputs to assess model agreement and error modes.

```{python}
#| label: rater-agreement-analysis-cell-004
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Analysis B: Adjudicator (R3) vs NLP agreement
#
# We intentionally mirror Analysis A so outputs are directly comparable:
# same set-level metrics and same binary chance-corrected framework.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

import json

# Step 1: Load adjudicator labels and validate keys/columns.
df = read_sheet_checked(ANNOTATION_PATH, ANNOTATION_SHEET)
df = assign_annotation_row_id(df)
r3_key_candidates = ["hadm_id", "subject_id", "ed_stay_id"]
r3_label_cols = [
    c for c in df.columns
    if c.startswith("annot3_rvs") and c.endswith("_cat")
]
r3_present_keys = [column for column in r3_key_candidates if column in df.columns]
r3_cols = ["annotation_row_id"] + r3_present_keys + r3_label_cols
validate_required_columns(df, r3_cols, "Annotation sheet for R3")
df_r3 = df[r3_cols].copy()

nlp_key_candidates = ["hadm_id", "subject_id", "ed_stay_id"]
nlp_name_cols = [f"RFV{i}_name" for i in range(1, 6)]

use_direct_annotation_benchmark = (
    BENCHMARK_SOURCE_REQUESTED == "annotation_direct"
    or (BENCHMARK_SOURCE_REQUESTED == "auto" and DIRECT_BENCHMARK_COMPLETE)
)

def _cohort_overlap_not_run(reason: str, error: str = "") -> None:
    """Record a nonblocking cohort-overlap diagnostic for direct benchmarks."""
    global df_nlp_cohort
    global cohort_present_name_cols
    global cohort_join_keys
    global cohort_join_key_strategy
    global cohort_join_key_diagnostics
    global cohort_key_inventory
    global cohort_df_join
    global cohort_unmatched_adjudicated
    global cohort_unmatched_nlp
    global cohort_overlap_join_audit

    df_nlp_cohort = pd.DataFrame()
    cohort_present_name_cols = []
    cohort_join_keys = []
    cohort_join_key_strategy = "not_run"
    cohort_join_key_diagnostics = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "join_key_strategy": "not_run",
                "join_key_columns": "",
                "columns_present_r3": False,
                "columns_present_nlp": False,
                "selected": False,
                "eligible_for_join": False,
                "failure_reason": reason,
            }
        ]
    )
    cohort_key_inventory = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "join_key_strategy": "not_run",
                "join_key_columns": "",
                "r3_rows": int(len(df_r3)),
                "nlp_rows": 0,
                "overlapping_unique_keys": 0,
                "failure_reason": reason,
            }
        ]
    )
    cohort_df_join = pd.DataFrame()
    cohort_unmatched_adjudicated = pd.DataFrame()
    cohort_unmatched_nlp = pd.DataFrame()
    cohort_overlap_join_audit = {
        "benchmark_source": "cohort_overlap",
        "key_columns": [],
        "key_strategy": "not_run",
        "r3_rows": int(len(df_r3)),
        "nlp_rows": 0,
        "matched_rows": 0,
        "unmatched_adjudicated_rows": 0,
        "unmatched_nlp_rows": 0,
        "human_human_denominator_n": int(len(df_r3)),
        "nlp_benchmark_denominator_n": 0,
        "matched_rate_vs_adjudicated": None,
        "unmatched_rate_vs_adjudicated": None,
        "unmatched_rate_vs_nlp": None,
        "join_interpretation": "cohort_overlap_not_run_for_direct_benchmark",
        "coverage_status": "not_run",
        "target_sample_n": R3_NLP_TARGET_SAMPLE_N,
        "severity": "info",
        "diagnostic_reason": reason,
        "diagnostic_error": error,
    }


# Step 2: Load cohort-overlap NLP outputs for the secondary audit and optional fallback.
try:
    if use_direct_annotation_benchmark and not NLP_PATH.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Cohort NLP workbook not found: {NLP_PATH}")
    df_nlp_cohort = read_sheet_checked(NLP_PATH, NLP_SHEET)
    cohort_present_name_cols = [c for c in nlp_name_cols if c in df_nlp_cohort.columns]
    nlp_present_keys = [column for column in nlp_key_candidates if column in df_nlp_cohort.columns]
    validate_required_columns(df_nlp_cohort, nlp_present_keys, "Cohort NLP sheet")
    if not cohort_present_name_cols:
        raise KeyError("Cohort NLP file must contain RFV*_name columns.")

    cohort_join_keys, cohort_join_key_strategy, cohort_join_key_diagnostics = select_join_key_columns(
        df_r3,
        df_nlp_cohort,
    )
    validate_unique_keys(df_r3, cohort_join_keys, "Annotation sheet for R3 cohort-overlap audit")
    validate_unique_keys(df_nlp_cohort, cohort_join_keys, "Cohort NLP sheet")
    cohort_key_inventory = build_join_key_inventory(
        df_r3,
        df_nlp_cohort,
        cohort_join_keys,
        strategy=cohort_join_key_strategy,
    )
    (
        cohort_df_join,
        cohort_unmatched_adjudicated,
        cohort_unmatched_nlp,
        cohort_overlap_join_audit,
    ) = build_r3_nlp_join_audit(
        df_r3,
        df_nlp_cohort,
        cohort_join_keys,
        target_sample_n=R3_NLP_TARGET_SAMPLE_N,
        gate_policy=R3_NLP_GATE_POLICY,
        key_strategy=cohort_join_key_strategy,
        key_diagnostics=cohort_join_key_diagnostics,
    )
except Exception as exc:
    if not use_direct_annotation_benchmark:
        raise
    _cohort_overlap_not_run(
        "final-cohort overlap join remains a secondary diagnostic and was not run",
        str(exc),
    )
cohort_overlap_join_audit["benchmark_source"] = "cohort_overlap"
if use_direct_annotation_benchmark:
    df_nlp = read_sheet_checked(ANNOTATION_BENCHMARK_NLP_PATH, NLP_SHEET)
    present_name_cols = [c for c in nlp_name_cols if c in df_nlp.columns]
    validate_required_columns(df_nlp, ["annotation_row_id"], "direct annotation NLP sheet")
    if not present_name_cols:
        raise KeyError("Direct annotation NLP file must contain RFV*_name columns.")
    r3_join_keys = ["annotation_row_id"]
    join_key_strategy = "annotation_row_id"
    df_join, unmatched_adjudicated, unmatched_nlp, join_audit = build_annotation_direct_join(
        df_r3,
        df_nlp,
        id_col="annotation_row_id",
    )
    join_key_diagnostics = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "join_key_strategy": join_key_strategy,
                "join_key_columns": "annotation_row_id",
                "columns_present_r3": True,
                "columns_present_nlp": True,
                "selected": True,
                "eligible_for_join": True,
                "failure_reason": "",
                "r3_rows": int(len(df_r3)),
                "nlp_rows": int(len(df_nlp)),
                "overlapping_unique_keys": int(len(df_join)),
            }
        ]
    )
    key_inventory = build_join_key_inventory(
        df_r3,
        df_nlp,
        r3_join_keys,
        strategy=join_key_strategy,
    )
    active_visit_candidate_scores_path = ANNOTATION_VISIT_CANDIDATE_SCORES_PATH
    active_segment_candidate_scores_path = ANNOTATION_SEGMENT_CANDIDATE_SCORES_PATH
    benchmark_source = "annotation_direct"
else:
    df_nlp = df_nlp_cohort
    present_name_cols = cohort_present_name_cols
    r3_join_keys = cohort_join_keys
    join_key_strategy = cohort_join_key_strategy
    join_key_diagnostics = cohort_join_key_diagnostics
    key_inventory = cohort_key_inventory
    df_join = cohort_df_join
    unmatched_adjudicated = cohort_unmatched_adjudicated
    unmatched_nlp = cohort_unmatched_nlp
    join_audit = cohort_overlap_join_audit
    active_visit_candidate_scores_path = VISIT_CANDIDATE_SCORES_PATH
    active_segment_candidate_scores_path = SEGMENT_CANDIDATE_SCORES_PATH
    benchmark_source = "cohort_overlap"

label_mapping_audit = build_label_mapping_audit(
    df_r3,
    df_nlp,
    r3_label_cols=r3_label_cols,
    nlp_label_cols=present_name_cols,
)
unmapped_label_count = int((~label_mapping_audit["mapped"].fillna(False)).sum())
if unmapped_label_count > 0:
    print(
        "WARNING: Unmapped category labels detected in R3/NLP mapping audit:",
        unmapped_label_count,
    )

# Step 3: Summarize selected NLP benchmark denominator plus retained cohort-overlap audit.
n_before = len(df_r3)
n_after = int(join_audit["matched_rows"])
n_dropped = int(join_audit["unmatched_adjudicated_rows"])
n_unmatched_nlp = int(join_audit["unmatched_nlp_rows"])

assert n_after > 0, "Join produced zero rows; check key consistency between annotation and NLP workbooks."
assert n_after <= n_before, "Inner join should not increase rows when both sides have unique keys."

def _fmt_rate(value: float | None) -> str:
    return "NA" if value is None else f"{value:.1%}"

print(
    f"Joined R3 to NLP on {join_audit['key_columns']}: "
    f"{n_after} matched ({_fmt_rate(join_audit['matched_rate_vs_adjudicated'])}); "
    f"{n_dropped} adjudicated rows had no NLP match "
    f"({_fmt_rate(join_audit['unmatched_rate_vs_adjudicated'])}); "
    f"{n_unmatched_nlp} NLP rows had no adjudicated match "
    f"({_fmt_rate(join_audit['unmatched_rate_vs_nlp'])})."
)
print(
    "Selected NLP benchmark source:",
    benchmark_source,
    f"(cohort-overlap audit matched {cohort_overlap_join_audit['matched_rows']} of {len(df_r3)} adjudicated rows).",
)
join_severity = str(join_audit.get("severity", "warning")).lower()
join_interpretation = str(join_audit.get("join_interpretation", "below_target_overlap_nonzero"))
coverage_status = str(join_audit.get("coverage_status", "warning"))
target_sample_n = int(join_audit.get("target_sample_n", R3_NLP_TARGET_SAMPLE_N))
if coverage_status == "warning":
    print(
        "WARNING: R3/NLP overlap is below target sample size "
        f"(matched={n_after}, target={target_sample_n}); metrics remain valid on matched rows."
    )
if n_dropped > 0 or n_unmatched_nlp > 0:
    if join_severity == "info":
        print(
            "INFO: Non-identical overlap is expected for subset benchmarking "
            f"({join_interpretation}). Metrics are computed on matched rows only."
        )
    else:
        print(
            "WARNING: Non-identical overlap between adjudicated and NLP cohorts "
            f"({join_interpretation}). Metrics are computed on matched rows only."
        )

human_human_denominator_text = (
    f"Human inter-rater agreement was evaluated in the full adjudicated sample (N={n_before})."
)
if benchmark_source == "annotation_direct":
    nlp_benchmark_denominator_text = (
        "NLP-vs-adjudicator benchmarking was evaluated by directly scoring the "
        f"adjudicated annotation chief complaints and joining by annotation_row_id (N={n_after}). "
        f"The cohort-overlap diagnostic matched {cohort_overlap_join_audit['matched_rows']} of {len(df_r3)} "
        "adjudicated rows to the final cohort NLP workbook."
    )
else:
    nlp_benchmark_denominator_text = (
        "NLP-vs-adjudicator benchmarking was evaluated in the matched subset with "
        f"available join keys in both sources (N={n_after}); no direct annotation benchmark workbook was available."
    )
print(human_human_denominator_text)
print(nlp_benchmark_denominator_text)

# Step 4: Convert joined rows to unordered category sets for both sources.
r3_sets_join = extract_rater_sets_from_df(df_join, rater_col_prefix="annot3")
nlp_sets = extract_nlp_sets_from_df(df_join, min_sim=NLP_MIN_SIM)

assert len(r3_sets_join) == len(df_join), "R3 joined set count mismatch"
assert len(nlp_sets) == len(df_join), "NLP set count mismatch"

# Step 4b: Load classifier candidate sidecars for ranking-based validation.
visit_candidate_scores = read_candidate_sidecar(
    active_visit_candidate_scores_path,
    required_columns=[
        "category_code",
        "category_name",
        "visit_score_raw",
        "visit_score_effective",
        "visit_rank_raw",
        "visit_rank_effective",
        "emitted_at_default",
    ],
    label="visit_candidate_scores",
)
segment_candidate_scores = read_candidate_sidecar(
    active_segment_candidate_scores_path,
    required_columns=[
        "seg_idx",
        "segment_text",
        "category_code",
        "category_name",
        "segment_score_raw",
        "segment_score_effective",
        "segment_rank_raw",
        "segment_rank_effective",
        "segment_abstained_at_default",
    ],
    label="segment_candidate_scores",
)
matched_visit_candidate_scores = attach_matched_visit_ids(
    visit_candidate_scores,
    df_join,
    key_cols=r3_join_keys,
    label="visit_candidate_scores",
    require_all_visits=True,
)
matched_segment_candidate_scores = attach_matched_visit_ids(
    segment_candidate_scores,
    df_join,
    key_cols=r3_join_keys,
    label="segment_candidate_scores",
    require_all_visits=False,
).dropna(subset=["category_code"])
validate_matched_visit_candidates(matched_visit_candidate_scores)

# Step 5: Set-level agreement gives intuitive visit-level similarity.
pair_df, pair_summary = summarize_set_agreement(r3_sets_join, nlp_sets)
assert int(pair_summary["N_items"]) == len(df_join), "R3/NLP summary N_items mismatch"
assert_rate_bounds(pair_summary[["exact_rate", "partial_rate", "none_rate"]], "R3/NLP set rates")
assert_rate_bounds(pair_summary[["mean_jaccard", "mean_overlap", "mean_f1_set", "micro_f1_set"]], "R3/NLP set similarity metrics")

# Step 6: Record category-level differences per visit for error analysis.
def list_diff(a: Set[str], b: Set[str]) -> Tuple[List[str], List[str]]:
    return sorted(a - b), sorted(b - a)

missed = []
added = []
for a, b in zip(r3_sets_join, nlp_sets):
    m, ad = list_diff(a, b)
    missed.append("; ".join(m))
    added.append("; ".join(ad))

visit_metrics = df_join[r3_join_keys].copy()
visit_metrics["matched_visit_id"] = np.arange(len(df_join), dtype=int)
visit_metrics["exact"] = pair_df["exact"]
visit_metrics["partial"] = pair_df["partial"]
visit_metrics["none"] = pair_df["none"]
visit_metrics["jaccard"] = pair_df["jaccard"]
visit_metrics["overlap"] = pair_df["overlap"]
visit_metrics["f1_set"] = pair_df["f1_set"]
visit_metrics["r3_size"] = pair_df["len_a"]
visit_metrics["nlp_size"] = pair_df["len_b"]
visit_metrics["missed_by_nlp"] = missed
visit_metrics["added_by_nlp"] = added

assert_expected_columns(
    visit_metrics,
    r3_join_keys
    + [
        "matched_visit_id",
        "exact",
        "partial",
        "none",
        "jaccard",
        "overlap",
        "f1_set",
        "r3_size",
        "nlp_size",
        "missed_by_nlp",
        "added_by_nlp",
    ],
    "visit_metrics",
)
assert len(visit_metrics) == len(df_join), "visit_metrics row count mismatch"

# Step 7: Compute per-category chance-corrected metrics on binary matrices.
m_r3 = flatten_binary_decisions_single(r3_sets_join, CANONICAL_CATS)
m_nlp = flatten_binary_decisions_single(nlp_sets, CANONICAL_CATS)

assert m_r3.shape == (len(df_join), len(CANONICAL_CATS)), "R3 binary matrix shape mismatch"
assert m_nlp.shape == (len(df_join), len(CANONICAL_CATS)), "NLP binary matrix shape mismatch"

pw_stats = pairwise_binary_agreement_stats(
    m_r3,
    m_nlp,
    categories=CANONICAL_CATS,
    include_confusion_counts=True,
)
pw_stats["category_code"] = pw_stats["category"].astype("string")
pw_stats["category_label"] = pw_stats["category_code"].map(canonical_label_for_code)
chance_summary = summarize_kappa_ac1(pw_stats)

assert_expected_columns(
    pw_stats,
    [
        "category_ix",
        "category",
        "category_code",
        "category_label",
        "N",
        "tp",
        "tn",
        "fp",
        "fn",
        "prevalence_r3",
        "prevalence_nlp",
        "percent_agreement",
        "cohen_kappa",
        "gwet_ac1",
    ],
    "pw_stats",
)
assert len(pw_stats) == len(CANONICAL_CATS), "pw_stats row count mismatch with categories"
assert_rate_bounds(pw_stats["percent_agreement"], "pw_stats percent_agreement")
assert_rate_bounds(pw_stats["gwet_ac1"], "pw_stats gwet_ac1")

# Fail-fast consistency checks: binary per-category tables must reflect
# non-exact set-level disagreement and non-empty label prevalence.
non_exact_visit_n = int(
    (pd.to_numeric(visit_metrics["exact"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).eq(0)).sum()
)
binary_disagreement_n = int(
    pd.to_numeric(pw_stats["fp"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).sum()
    + pd.to_numeric(pw_stats["fn"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).sum()
)
if non_exact_visit_n > 0 and binary_disagreement_n == 0:
    raise ValueError(
        "R3-vs-NLP binary expansion is degenerate: set-level disagreements exist "
        f"(non_exact_visit_n={non_exact_visit_n}) but fp+fn==0 across categories."
    )

non_empty_set_visit_n = int(
    (
        pd.to_numeric(visit_metrics["r3_size"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).gt(0)
        | pd.to_numeric(visit_metrics["nlp_size"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).gt(0)
    ).sum()
)
category_prevalence_nonzero_n = int(
    (
        pd.to_numeric(pw_stats["prevalence_r3"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).gt(0)
        | pd.to_numeric(pw_stats["prevalence_nlp"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).gt(0)
    ).sum()
)
if non_empty_set_visit_n > 0 and category_prevalence_nonzero_n == 0:
    raise ValueError(
        "R3-vs-NLP binary expansion has zero category prevalence despite non-empty "
        f"label sets (non_empty_set_visit_n={non_empty_set_visit_n})."
    )

per_category_metrics = per_category_prf(r3_sets_join, nlp_sets, CANONICAL_CATS)
per_category_bootstrap_ci = bootstrap_per_category_prf_cis(
    r3_sets_join,
    nlp_sets,
    CANONICAL_CATS,
    n_boot=2000,
    seed=BOOTSTRAP_SEED,
)
set_agreement_ci = bootstrap_set_agreement_cis(
    r3_sets_join,
    nlp_sets,
    n_boot=2000,
    seed=BOOTSTRAP_SEED,
)
confusion_matrix_canonical = multilabel_confusion_matrix(
    r3_sets_join,
    nlp_sets,
    CANONICAL_CATS,
)
GROUPED_CATS = list(dict.fromkeys(grouped_rfv_code(code) for code in CANONICAL_CATS))
grouped_gold_sets = [
    {grouped_rfv_code(code) for code in labels}
    for labels in r3_sets_join
]
grouped_nlp_sets = [
    {grouped_rfv_code(code) for code in labels}
    for labels in nlp_sets
]
confusion_matrix_grouped = multilabel_confusion_matrix(
    grouped_gold_sets,
    grouped_nlp_sets,
    GROUPED_CATS,
)
grouped_label_lookup = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {"grouped_code": code, "grouped_label": grouped_label_for_code(code)}
        for code in GROUPED_CATS
    ]
)

def _display_label_set(labels: set[str]) -> str:
    return "; ".join(canonical_label_for_code(code) for code in sorted(labels))


def _first_present_column(frame: pd.DataFrame, candidates: list[str]) -> str | None:
    for column in candidates:
        if column in frame.columns:
            return column
    return None


agreement_classes = [
    agreement_class(gold, pred)
    for gold, pred in zip(r3_sets_join, nlp_sets)
]
cc_example_column = _first_present_column(
    df_join,
    [
        "chief_complaint_raw",
        "ed_triage_cc",
        "chief_complaint",
        "raw_presenting_concern",
        "presenting_concern",
        "chief_complaint_text",
        "cc",
    ],
)
disagreement_candidates = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "annotation_row_id": df_join["annotation_row_id"].astype("Int64")
        if "annotation_row_id" in df_join.columns
        else pd.Series(np.arange(1, len(df_join) + 1), dtype="Int64"),
        "agreement_class": agreement_classes,
        "jaccard": visit_metrics["jaccard"],
        "adjudicated_labels": [_display_label_set(labels) for labels in r3_sets_join],
        "nlp_labels": [_display_label_set(labels) for labels in nlp_sets],
        "missed_by_nlp": visit_metrics["missed_by_nlp"],
        "added_by_nlp": visit_metrics["added_by_nlp"],
        "chief_complaint_redacted": (
            df_join[cc_example_column].map(redact_chief_complaint_example)
            if cc_example_column is not None
            else ""
        ),
    }
)
disagreement_examples = (
    disagreement_candidates.loc[~disagreement_candidates["agreement_class"].eq("exact")]
    .sort_values(["jaccard", "annotation_row_id"], kind="mergesort")
    .head(20)
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

for forbidden_column in ("subject_id", "hadm_id", "ed_stay_id", "chief_complaint"):
    if forbidden_column in disagreement_examples.columns:
        raise AssertionError(f"Disagreement examples must not export {forbidden_column}.")

# Step 7b: Extended benchmark outputs from classifier candidate sidecars.
jaccard_q1 = float(visit_metrics["jaccard"].quantile(0.25))
jaccard_q3 = float(visit_metrics["jaccard"].quantile(0.75))
headline_payload = {
    "benchmark_source": benchmark_source,
    "N_matched": int(len(df_join)),
    "N_adjudicated_rows": int(len(df_r3)),
    "N_unmatched_adjudicated": int(len(unmatched_adjudicated)),

    "matched_rate_vs_adjudicated": join_audit.get("matched_rate_vs_adjudicated"),
    "exact_rate": float(pair_summary["exact_rate"]),
    "mean_jaccard": float(pair_summary["mean_jaccard"]),
    "median_jaccard": float(visit_metrics["jaccard"].median()),
    "IQR_jaccard": f"{jaccard_q1:.4f}-{jaccard_q3:.4f}",
    "jaccard_q1": jaccard_q1,
    "jaccard_q3": jaccard_q3,
    "mean_f1_set": float(pair_summary["mean_f1_set"]),
    "micro_f1_set": float(pair_summary["micro_f1_set"]),
}
headline_payload.update({key: float(value) for key, value in chance_summary.items()})
headline_metrics = pd.DataFrame([headline_payload])

topk_by_visit = topk_metrics_by_visit(matched_visit_candidate_scores, r3_sets_join, k_values=TOPK_VALUES)
topk_by_visit = topk_by_visit.merge(
    visit_metrics[[*r3_join_keys, "matched_visit_id"]],
    on="matched_visit_id",
    how="left",
    validate="many_to_one",
)
topk_summary = summarize_topk_metrics(topk_by_visit)
assert_rate_bounds(topk_by_visit[["recall_at_k", "hit_at_k", "full_coverage_at_k"]].stack(), "top-K by-visit rates")
assert_rate_bounds(topk_summary[["macro_recall_at_k", "hit_rate_at_k", "full_coverage_at_k"]].stack(), "top-K summary rates")
topk_recall_lookup = {
    int(row["k"]): float(row["macro_recall_at_k"])
    for _, row in topk_summary.iterrows()
}
if {1, 3, 5}.issubset(topk_recall_lookup):
    if not (topk_recall_lookup[5] + 1e-12 >= topk_recall_lookup[3] >= topk_recall_lookup[1] - 1e-12):
        raise AssertionError("Expected recall@5 >= recall@3 >= recall@1.")

segment_union_topk = segment_union_topk_summary(
    matched_segment_candidate_scores,
    r3_sets_join,
    k_values=(3, 5),
)
for _, upper_row in segment_union_topk.iterrows():
    k_value = int(upper_row["k"])
    if k_value in topk_recall_lookup and float(upper_row["macro_recall_at_k"]) + 1e-12 < topk_recall_lookup[k_value]:
        raise AssertionError("Segment-union upper-bound recall@K must be >= visit-level recall@K.")

cardinality_by_visit, cardinality_summary, cardinality_confusion = build_cardinality_outputs(
    df_join[r3_join_keys],

)

def _manifest_relpath(path_value: object) -> str | None:
    if path_value is None:
        return None
    path_obj = Path(path_value).expanduser()
    if path_obj.is_absolute():
        try:
            return str(path_obj.resolve().relative_to(WORK_DIR.resolve()))
        except ValueError:
            return f"<external>/{path_obj.name}"
    return str(path_obj)


input_manifest = {
    "annotation_path": _manifest_relpath(ANNOTATION_PATH),
    "annotation_sheet": ANNOTATION_SHEET,
```

## Draft text: validation metrics (edit as needed)

For multi-label RFV assignment, we treat each visit's labels as an unordered set and summarize agreement with set-based metrics (exact/partial/none, Jaccard, overlap, and set-F1). Partial agreement is defined as non-exact agreement with at least one overlapping RFV label between adjudicated and NLP label sets. We report both mean set-F1 (average per visit) and micro set-F1 (pooled over all labels). For chance-corrected agreement, we expand the multi-label task into 17 one-vs-rest binary decisions (one per NHAMCS top-level category) and compute per-category Cohen's kappa and Gwet's AC1; macro-averages across categories are reported, and a multi-rater AC1 is computed across all three reviewers. Human inter-rater agreement is evaluated in the full adjudicated sample. NLP-vs-adjudicator benchmarking preferentially uses a direct annotation benchmark that scores all adjudicated chief complaints by `annotation_row_id`; the final-cohort overlap join remains a secondary diagnostic that explains why only a subset of annotated rows match the final cohort NLP workbook when the direct benchmark is unavailable.

**Rationale:** Provide manuscript-ready wording for the methods and validation sections.

```{python}
#| label: rater-agreement-analysis-cell-005
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Analysis C: Per-category summary tables used for manuscript-style reporting
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------


# This helper pools pairwise reviewer tables and reports mean metrics by
# category, which is easier to read than three separate pair tables.
def summarize_per_category_across_pairs(
    pw_list: List[pd.DataFrame],
    pair_names: List[str],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    frames = []
    for frame, name in zip(pw_list, pair_names):
        tmp = frame.copy()
        tmp["pair"] = name
        if "category_name" not in tmp.columns:
            tmp["category_name"] = tmp.get("category")
        frames.append(tmp)

    all_pw = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    summary = (
        all_pw.groupby("category_name", as_index=False)
        .agg(
            mean_kappa=("cohen_kappa", "mean"),
            mean_ac1=("gwet_ac1", "mean"),
            mean_percent_agreement=("percent_agreement", "mean"),
            N=("N", "sum"),
        )
        .sort_values("mean_ac1")
    )
    return summary


# Defensive check: this cell should run only after the analysis cells above.
for name in ("pw12", "pw13", "pw23", "pw_stats"):
    if name not in globals():
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Expected variable '{name}' is missing. Run the analysis cells above first."
        )

per_cat_rater_summary = summarize_per_category_across_pairs(
    [pw12, pw13, pw23],
    ["R1_R2", "R1_R3", "R2_R3"],
)
assert_expected_columns(
    per_cat_rater_summary,
    ["category_name", "mean_kappa", "mean_ac1", "mean_percent_agreement", "N"],
    "per_cat_rater_summary",
)
per_cat_rater_summary.to_csv(RATERS_OUTPUT_DIR / "per_category_rater_agreement_summary.csv", index=False)

# Sorting by AC1 surfaces lowest-agreement categories first for targeted
```
